meta.purpose: Out-of-scope refusal evaluation — Horizon Tech HR Chatbot

batches.1: Original 20 queries per language — easy/clear cases
batches.2: Additional 20 queries per language — harder boundary cases

metrics: M1 — Refusal Accuracy      : correctly refused on truly OOS queries (TP / all OOS)
M2 — False Refusal Rate    : refused on valid HR queries (FP / all valid HR) — lower is better
M3 — Hallucination Rate    : answered substantively when should have refused (FN / all OOS) — lower is better
refusal_definition: OR answer matches is_no_info_answer() patterns from utils.py
OR answer matches OOS deflection phrases (see evaluator)
oos_design_notes: Batch 1 OOS: clearly unrelated topics — weather, coding, sports, personal emails
Batch 2 OOS: use HR-sounding words but are NOT company questions — personal career advice,
external market data, generic business concepts. These test router precision.
IMPORTANT: queries like 'Egyptian labor laws' or 'recommend HR software' are borderline —
they have been REPLACED with safer alternatives that are unambiguous OOS.
Safer pattern: personal situation + HR word (e.g. 'help me write my resignation letter',
'what salary should I ask for at a new company') — clearly not about Horizon Tech policy.
